# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old as of Volume 5 (v05:c36:p0027)  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c37 P33](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered a stout or plump girl. She possesses a short-featured face and a malicious smile. She is known for wearing dresses with flounces and large sleeve puffs, though others have remarked that fairy queens should be slender rather than fat like her.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is notoriously malicious, vain, arrogant, and outspoken. She frequently makes spiteful and uncharitable comments about her schoolmates' looks, clothes, and origins. Possessing a sharp tongue, she enjoys triumphs over others and is quick to show scorn or sulk when she does not get her way. Despite her unpleasant demeanour, she exhibits an inborn gift for physical feats like walking board fences.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v3 c34 P19](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0019)_

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea School, where she frequently clashed with Anne Shirley and other classmates. During her school years, she engaged in cheating during spelling lessons and dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, which resulted in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Later, Josie joined the Queen's Academy preparation class and studied at Queen's alongside Anne, Gilbert, and Jane Andrews. After graduating from Queen's, she attended Redmond College in Kingsport for higher education. Throughout her college years, Josie maintained a spiteful attitude towards Anne, making condescending remarks about Anne's background, writing, and romance, and falsely claiming Anne's prize-winning story was plagiarized. After completing her studies at Redmond, she planned to return for a second year.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002), [v3 c15 P6](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0006), [v3 c37 P33](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the Pye family of Avonlea, a family known locally for cheating, bad tempers, and disagreeable traits  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Redmond College in Kingsport to pursue an Arts degree  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 c37 P33](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0033)</sub>
